cohort: Men born in Sweden between 1973 and 1983 (n=522,216), including 2,689 men with CHD
finding: Although men with CHD were more likely to have been born preterm, small-for-gestational age, or large-for-gestational age, their offspring did not experience higher rates of these outcomes.
mod_finding: Men with CHD were more likely to have been born via cesarean section.
